description: arXiv:2609.09856v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid adoption of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT has sparked intense debate about their risks and opportunities for education, as well as the ways researchers should investigate them. In this paper, we approach these discussions through an analogy with the Thermomix, a smart kitchen appliance that has similarly provoked both enthusiasm...
author: Nikol Rummel, Valentina Nachtigall, Ernesto Panadero
